project.name: shopflow-cache
project.description: Caching techniques as a small library: eviction (LRU/LFU/FIFO/TTL), read strategies (cache-aside / read-through), write strategies (write-through / write-behind / write-around / invalidate), and stampede protection (single-flight, TTL jitter, negative caching). Pure Java, no Spring, fully unit-tested — a plain library like shopflow-outbox (it never boots).
